name: Shimei
bio: Shimei son of Gera was a Benjamite from Saul's clan who came out cursing David as he fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion, pelting him and his officials with stones and shouting, "Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel! The LORD has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned, and the LORD has given the kingdom into the hands of your son Absalom" (2 Samuel 16:5-8). Abishai wanted to go over and cut off his head, but David refused, saying that if his own son sought his life, this Benjamite's cursing was nothing to stop, and that the LORD might yet see his affliction and repay him with good for the cursing he endured that day (2 Samuel 16:9-13). Shimei continued cursing, throwing stones, and flinging dust at David all along the road. When David returned to Jerusalem after Absalom's defeat, Shimei hurried down with a thousand Benjamites to meet him, fell down before the king, and begged him not to hold his earlier cursing against him: "Your servant knows that I have sinned. But today I have come here as the first from the tribes of Joseph to come down and meet my lord the king" (2 Samuel 19:16-20). Abishai again wanted him put to death for cursing "the LORD's anointed," but David refused to let anyone be executed on the very day he was reclaiming his kingdom, and swore to Shimei that he would not die (2 Samuel 19:21-23). On his deathbed, David instructed Solomon not to consider his earlier oath to Shimei a reason to let him go unpunished, recalling the grievous curse Shimei had hurled at him (1 Kings 2:8-9). Once his throne was secure, Solomon summoned Shimei and confined him to Jerusalem, warning that the day he left the city for any reason, he would die; Shimei agreed and lived there peaceably for three years. When two of his slaves ran off to Gath, Shimei went after them and brought them back, breaking the terms of his confinement. Solomon confronted him over the broken oath and the old wickedness against David, and had Benaiah strike him down, finally settling a reckoning that had hung over Shimei since the day he first cursed David fleeing Jerusalem (1 Kings 2:36-46).
